data.title: XRP Ledger Account Count Falls as Transaction Size Nearly Triples, Evernorth Says
data.description: Evernorth reported that XRP Ledger account numbers declined while average transaction size nearly tripled. Network total value, driven by stablecoins, rose above $4.2 billion. According to ChainCatcher, the report points to a shift in network activity even as overall value on the ledger increased.

data.title: AEREDIUM Launches AERSeal to Replace Single-Private-Key Smart Contract Control
data.description:
PeckShield said the crypto industry suffered 50 major hacking incidents in August 2026, up 67% from July, while losses fell 49.5% to $136.3 million. Tectonicfi accounted for about $74 million of the losses, and only about $6 million was transferred out after Cronos paused its network. According to Odaily, digital asset security company AEREDIUM has launched AERSeal, which is designed to replace the single private key used to control privileged smart contract functions with threshold signatures requiring multiple authorizations.

AERSeal stores key shares in hardware-certified secure enclaves and supports the Ethereum Virtual Machine and compatible chains. According to Odaily, the product does not reconstruct a full private key and instead generates signatures through the CGGMP24 threshold signature protocol. AEREDIUM founder and CEO Albert Dadon said the product can transfer minting and upgrade permissions to threshold keys and use on-chain verification to confirm completion of the transfer. Customers can also independently verify the assigned threshold keys.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Malaysia’s PAS Seeks Review of Gambling Licenses
data.description:
Parti Islam Se-Malaysia, which leads Malaysia’s main opposition bloc, said the government should review existing gambling licenses and stop issuing new ones, according to Bloomberg.

The party said the move is part of its latest effort to curb social ills.

data.title: Bitdeer Reports 282 BTC Mined and Sold in Week Ending September 4
data.description: Nasdaq-listed Bitcoin miner Bitdeer said it produced 282 BTC in the week ending September 4 and sold the same amount during the period. According to Odaily, the company reported net additions of zero BTC and said it still holds no Bitcoin.

data.title: Dutch Central Bank Moves Gold Reserves From North America To London
data.description:
According to the BBC, De Nederlandsche Bank said it moved 86 tonnes of gold from the US and Canada to London between March and August this year, citing increasing geopolitical unrest and the need to be better prepared for severe crises. The Dutch central bank said the metal is now held in the Bank of England’s vaults, while some 27 tonnes were physically transferred to the Dutch town of Zeist and a similar amount was sent from Zeist to London.

The report said the move came as central banks have been buying more gold, with the World Gold Council saying they accumulated an annual average of 1,000 tonnes over the past four years, up from 500 tonnes in the previous decade. Goldman Sachs researchers Lina Thomas and Daan Struyven said reserve managers are increasingly focused on where to store gold, while the bank’s analysts forecast the price will rise to $4,900 per troy ounce by the end of 2026.

data.title: Von Der Leyen To Visit Greenland Amid Trump Pressure
data.description:
According to CNBC, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen will travel to Greenland's capital on Sunday and is expected to announce fresh funding for the self-governing Danish territory during her second trip to Nuuk with Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen. The visit comes as U.S. President Donald Trump renews his push to acquire Greenland on national security grounds, while Greenlandic Prime Minister Jens-Frederik Nielsen said the EU has shown support for Greenland in the geopolitical situation and that he looks forward to sharing more about the Joint Declaration for Greenland.

The EU's funding package for 2026 and 2027 may amount to 200 million euros ($232.4 million) and could target critical minerals, renewable energy and undersea cables. Von der Leyen previously opened the European Commission's office in Nuuk in March 2024 and signed cooperation agreements worth close to 94 million euros at the time.

data.title: Polish Lower House Fails to Override President's Veto of Crypto Regulation Bill
data.description:
Poland's lower house failed on September 4 to override President Karol Nawrocki's veto of a cryptocurrency regulation bill. According to Odaily, lawmakers voted 241 to 198, with three abstentions, falling 25 votes short of the 266 needed.

The bill would have designated the Polish Financial Supervision Authority, KNF, as the regulator for the crypto market and was vetoed by Nawrocki for the third time. Nawrocki said the bill would overregulate the industry and could push Polish companies abroad, while Prime Minister Donald Tusk cited an investigation involving the now-defunct exchange Zondacrypto before the vote and urged lawmakers to support the bill.

data.title: Russia's Africa Corps Helps Niger Junta Quell Mutiny At Niamey Air Base
data.description: According to the BBC, Russia's Africa Corps helped Nigerien loyalist forces retake Air Base 101 at Diori Hamani International Airport after mutinous soldiers seized the strategic military base in Niamey last Saturday. Russia's ambassador to Niger, Viktor Voropaev, said Moscow's forces helped "repress a mutiny," while analysts said the intervention underscored Niger's growing dependence on Russia for security. The report said Africa Corps, which is directly controlled by Russia's defense ministry, has about 200 to 300 personnel in Niger and has also played a role in repelling an attack at the same airport in January. It added that Russia's support for Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso is tied to protecting allied governments, access to resources such as uranium and gold, and maintaining diplomatic influence, even as insurgent attacks by militants linked to al-Qaeda and Islamic State continue in Niger.

data.title: STOCKS | Jefferies Fund Exposure to Radiant World and Another Entity Nears $500 Million
data.description:
A Jefferies-managed fund that previously lent to bankrupt auto parts group First Brands Group now has nearly $500 million of exposure to troubled iron ore trader Radiant World and another entity, making it one of the largest creditors in the second high-profile alleged fraud case. According to Sina Finance, people familiar with the matter said Jefferies Asset Management obtained a freezing order of up to $499 million from the High Court in London last week covering Radiant World, its founder Pankaj Nahar, alleged affiliate Sapphire Minmetals, and its chairman Rakesh Sethi.

The exposure is far above previously reported levels and underscores the fund's role as a key source of financing for the two iron ore traders. According to Sina Finance, the private credit fund Point Bonita, part of Jefferies' Leucadia Asset Management unit, was hit again after the First Brands Group collapse, and Jefferies disclosed in October last year that its exposure to the Ohio-based company was $715 million.

People familiar with the matter said the trade finance fund began providing financing to Radiant in 2021, and the exposure grew from $35 million to several hundred million dollars over the following four years. They added that after First Brands' bankruptcy, Point Bonita faced large investor redemptions and stopped renewing existing credit lines to the commodities trader, triggering a liquidity crisis at Radiant.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Horizon Robotics CEO Yu Kai Says Company Aims for No. 1 Share in China Autonomous Driving Chips Next Year
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, at the opening ceremony of the 2026 Yabuli Forum Summer Annual Meeting held in Chengdu from September 4 to 6, Horizon Robotics founder and CEO Yu Kai said the company aims to rank first in China's autonomous driving chip market next year, surpassing Nvidia.

data.title: Robinhood-Linked Meme Coins Fall as Vlad Tenev Defends Tokenization
data.description: Robinhood-linked meme coins fell broadly, with MEME down 41.32% over six hours, microduck down 30.28% over 24 hours, CASHCAT down 14.19% over 24 hours, AI down 10.25% over 24 hours, and BONER down 26.15% over 24 hours. According to Odaily, Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev said tokenization could give global users access to high-quality financial assets and that the industry is still in its early stages.

data.title: Jump Trading Adds Office Space in Hong Kong IFC
data.description:
Jump Trading is adding office space in Hong Kong’s IFC Building, according to people familiar with the matter, Bloomberg reported.

The move is the latest sign of global trading firms expanding their presence in the city.

data.title: OpenAI and Microsoft Sued by Seattle Times and Newsday Over AI Training Use
data.description: According to Jin10, The Seattle Times and Newsday sued OpenAI and Microsoft (MSFT.O) on Friday in federal court, accusing the two technology companies of copying their newspaper reporting without permission to train their artificial intelligence systems.

data.title: Polymarket Cardinals Option Drops From 84% to 12.5%
data.description: The St. Louis Cardinals option in Polymarket’s market for the St. Louis Cardinals vs. Colorado Rockies fell sharply from 84% one hour ago to 12.5%, a 71.5 percentage point swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move was recorded by Catcher Predict monitoring and may reflect the impact of breaking news.

data.title: Ryan Berckmans Says Robinhood Is Highly Aligned With Ethereum
data.description:
Ethereum builder and investor Ryan Berckmans said on X that the idea Robinhood gives little back to ETH is nonsense. According to ChainCatcher, he said Robinhood pays on-chain users and new ETH holders, runs marketing to attract new enterprise customers, supports mature L1 hubs and L2 expansion, and creates healthy competition for Base.

Berckmans said Ethereum alignment is a real concept, but not in the way critics frame it as maximizing revenue and fees. He said helping Ethereum and ETH grow is aligned, while threatening Ethereum or ETH is anti-aligned, citing Lido during its dominant period as an example. He added that Robinhood is one of the most Ethereum-aligned entities globally.

He said buying large amounts of ETH or not selling order-flow fees would be better, but only as an incremental benefit. Berckmans added that the next wave of ETH buyers will include Wall Street, corporate, government, family office, and sovereign wealth buyers, and said ETH could reach trillions of dollars in value as Ethereum becomes globally adopted. He said the two key measures of value-store progress are L1 application capital and the number of sufficiently successful L2s, and that Robinhood helps grow the latter.

data.title: Trader LaserCat397 Loses $64,400 on SLINK After Buying During Rally
data.description: On-chain data showed that trader LaserCat397 bought SLINK in two transactions during a rapid price surge, spending about $69,700 in total. According to Odaily, the trader later sold when SLINK's market value had fallen to about $1.9 million and recovered only about $5,295, resulting in a loss of roughly $64,400, or 92.42%.

data.title: Bolivia Barracks Blast Kills At Least Two, Injures 58
data.description: According to the BBC, at least two people were killed and 58 injured after an explosion at a military barracks in Viacha, about 30km from La Paz, with authorities warning the toll could rise. Bolivian Defence Minister Ernesto Justiniano said “pyrotechnic material” detonated at about 14:30 (18:30 GMT) on Friday at the base, where an artillery regiment is stationed. Health official Rita Nebraska told local television that between 10 and 15 people were believed to have died, while police said dozens of homes were damaged and emergency workers were searching the rubble. Nebraska warned of a risk of further explosions and urged people to stay at least 150m away from the military base. Police spokesman Roger Roca said fireworks had been stored at the barracks and that the cause remained under investigation. Viacha authorities declared three days of mourning.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Japan Reports Progress on $550 Billion US Investment Pact
data.description: Japanese Trade Minister Ryosei Akazawa said progress was being made on a $550 billion investment initiative tied to a trade deal with the US last year, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Trader Loses About $907,000 After Two FOMO Trades in One Day
data.description:
A trader suffered combined losses of about $907,000 after making two consecutive FOMO trades in one day on September 5. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the trader first spent $916,500 to buy 7.28 million MEME at $0.126 each, then sold the position for only $353,000, resulting in a loss of $563,000 and a 61.45% decline.

The trader later invested $356,000 to buy 8.93 million SLINK at $0.04 each, but eventually sold for about $12,000, losing $344,000 in the process. The second trade represented a 96.62% drop.

BlockBeats reminded users that most meme coins have no practical use cases and are highly volatile, urging investors to protect their assets and avoid FOMO.

data.title: Hong Kong’s Lee Pledges Wider Offshore Yuan Use in Five-Year Plan
data.description:
Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee said the city’s first five-year plan will focus on expanding offshore yuan usage and cross-border investment with the mainland, according to Bloomberg.

Lee said the plan will also cover other areas, but gave no further details.
